tools-ci.title: Tools and CI
tools-ci.status: Two read-only tools reviews integrated:226 original tests plus77 additional tests (reports6565979619/6565996723/6566258844), plus six added synthetic inventory checks and eleven house-measurement tests reviewed separately. tools-ci.keepSummary: honest CI coverage and publication, trustworthy measurements, deterministic isolation, research provenance and safe preview tooling
protections: CI cannot turn missing history, a failed prerequisite or stale proof into a pass.
Preview publishing preserves the live site and other builders’ files.
Measurements compare equivalent inputs and distinguish missing telemetry from zero.
Interleaved worlds and settings preserve deterministic state and tuning fingerprints.
Research seeds, source identities and report denominators remain auditable.

groups.title: Measurement and diagnostic contracts

groups.reason: Supplied traces, fake clocks/workers/GL and shader source tokens test honest telemetry, comparison boundaries and performance budgets. The30000 upload calls and256 masks are synthetic coverage, not game populations. Intentional shader changes may require a separately reviewed baseline; no replacing ruling was established. House reviewer verified eleven synthetic CPU attribution/quantile/missing-data, held-clock, draw/finish, PNG-drift and census-reconciliation tests; these are measurement integrity, not generated-house outcomes.

groups.title: Generated-world fingerprints and repeat-night isolation
groups.question: Keep this group unchanged?
groups.reason: These do step generated games (240/600-step paths plus short wave advances). Assertions compare matched state, semantic fingerprint sensitivity and reset behavior rather than wins, survival or kills. The historical15.605 file seconds remain integrity work, not a savings proposal.
examples: is the same for a knob added, a note edited, or the groups reordered: the tuning file is an input, not the state
the second night is the night played fresh
a new game puts the fight's settings back as a page starts them (the last night's are read before its first fight)
exampleLabels: Notes and unused knobs do not change the game fingerprint.
The second night equals a fresh matching night.
A new game resets previous fight settings.

groups.title: Research, architecture and generated data
groups.question: Keep this group unchanged?
groups.reason: Most inputs are fabricated rows/configs. Screen tests validate frozen experiment controls and gate text, not whether a bot wins. Toy ask/tell scores protect resumability. Tiny real expert-contract cases assert provenance, replay equality and honest unsupported results. The inventory classifier tests pass strings like advance(world); they never advance a world. Newly added synthetic inventory cases have been reviewed by the integrator. Second review6566258844 adds20 schema/architecture/reference contracts and11 change-history/site-publication cases. Old import boundaries are parity inputs; the NEW schema graph excludes game/render/DOM. Knob-date checks validate metadata format, not every ruling’s design currentness. Changelog34 is a frozen archive sanity floor; Pages tests preserve selected source and latest live snapshot, not a game outcome.
examples: external rows cannot leak held-out pairs or first-round reserved survey pairs
merge refuses duplicates, wrong cells, missing shards, missing progression and model drift
preserves enums, records, nullable values and optional keys without adding constraints
exampleLabels: Held-out and reserved seeds cannot leak into training rows.
Survey merges reject duplicate or missing work.
Generated types retain optional and nullable fields.

groups.title: Preview and visual-review tool integrity
groups.question: Keep this group unchanged?
groups.reason: Throwaway Git fixtures, small typed arrays/depth bits, stubbed wrappers and glyph/genome records prove safe tooling and opted-in comparisons. Deterministic shape/ink constants are readability rules, not night outcomes. Art/creature owners should confirm a future acceptance-constant change. The32 art-cache handoff tests parse ASTs/hash source/JSON/binary bytes and use fake command exits, not drawing. They require fail-closed dependency analysis, exact successful keys, initialization-order coverage and old-v1 exact-input compatibility. Copy-heavy real-source fixtures account for historical cost but are not outcome simulations.
examples: adds only the named files, whatever is staged or missing in the checkout
keeps adjacent sampled float32 depths distinct instead of re-quantizing to DEPTH24
default-off and unknown switch preserve every production record by identity and hash
exampleLabels: Preview publishing adds only the named files.
Depth readback preserves distinct neighboring values.
An unused preview switch preserves production data.

groups.title: One mixed replay and fixture-sanity case
groups.question: Ask the report/combat owner to separate fixture-sanity predicates from this replay test? Yes opens a targeted follow-up review; deterministic replay and accounting stay blocking. It does not move or delete the case.
groups.reason: One declaration runs30/5s real cases plus stun fixtures15/30s. Repeated runs and phase accounting are hard integrity proofs; censored/stunned/hits>0/retaliation>0 predicates also validate the selected scenario. This is not a demonstrated pure outcome test to move wholesale. Exact purpose needs its report/combat owner.
examples: real-rules replay is deterministic across interleaved bots and bags
exampleLabels: Interleaved bots and bags replay deterministically.

groups.title: Separate coordination-plugin contracts
groups.reason: Fourteen contracts mock tool replies, clocks and session identity. They protect required status/option fields, atomic batches, version-pinned activity stamps and wake-thread identity. The plugin still has manifest/hooks, but live activation was not verified. These are OUTSIDE Witch Vitest includes, their timing is UNKNOWN, and no Witch CI saving is established. Activation/applicability remains with dev-ops owner.
groups.question: Keep the separate coordination-plugin contracts?

a batch is refused whole when one entry breaks the contract
a page-comment wake is told whose wake thread it came on (Topic, 2026-10-05)
exampleLabels: A page item requires a status.
